high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "theartment." The post features a decorative owl figurine as the main subject. The owl is intricately designed with detailed patterns on its feathers and body, giving it a rustic golden-winged appearance. It is placed on a wooden surface, likely a table or desk, which also holds a stack of books and a modern lamp with a wooden base and a white shade. The background includes a potted plant to the left and part of a chair with a dark cushion to the right.
